transcript.title: Opening
transcript.text: Good morning Rushil Bhatia. Here is your daily news for Saturday, September 12. In today's briefing: top headlines, bhopal and madhya pradesh, business and markets, money, tax and personal finance, science and technology, development and policy, across india, around the world. Let's begin.

transcript.title: Top headlines
transcript.text: First, the stories leading the news this morning. Zverev beats Khachanov, reaches US Open final and eyes second major of year. Alexander Zverev battled his way to the US Open final, showcasing resilience in a gripping match. Having triumphed at the French Open earlier this year, he now faces an American in the championship, a historic moment as the U.S. has lacked a men's Grand Slam champion since 2003. This final is a crucial chance for Zverev to cement his legacy with another prestigious title. After Trump renames Lake Ontario, Republican wants Lake Erie renamed too. US President Donald Trump has signed an executive order directing federal agencies to rename Lake Ontario as "Lake America" on US maps, documents and databases. Canada has rejected the move, while several US governors have also said they will continue calling it Lake Ontario. The decision comes amid rising trade tensions between Washington and Ottawa. Elon Musk's Cybercab rollout puts US safety rules to test as NHTSA audits 1,000 cars. Tesla's new Cybercab robotaxis are now operating in Texas without traditional controls. The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration has opened an audit of these vehicles. US safety regulations were primarily designed for human-driven cars. Tesla's strategy relies on self-driving software and robotics for its valuation. SC's 13 queries to FSSAI: 'Give details on shape, size, colour of food label'. The Supreme Court has mandated that the FSSAI outline precise details about food warning labels, including their design, dimensions, colors, and position on food packaging. Additionally, the court emphasizes the importance of communicating junk food risks to children. FSSAI is tasked with addressing thirteen specific inquiries within ten days, noting while progress has been made, more detailed clarification is still necessary. Brics 2026: Officials claim 50 outcomes, but no clarity on united declaration. NEW DELHI: India's Brics presidency has yielded over 50 tangible and practical outcomes, including frameworks and action plans, across the four priority pillars of resilience, innovation, cooperation and sustainability, official sources said ahead of the summit that begins Saturday. Countries where you can buy iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max cheaper than India. Apple's new iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max models have officially launched worldwide. These devices feature the powerful A20 Pro chip and improved camera technology. Pricing for these flagship iPhones varies considerably across different countries. The United States offers the most affordable purchase option for both models. 40 percent of global GDP is here: PM Modi on Brics Summit. NEW DELHI: Noting that the Brics grouping now represents 50 percent of the global population, 40 percent of GDP, and 25 percent of trade, PM Narendra Modi said Friday that their collective economic might has grown at nearly double the global pace since the bloc was formed in 2006, and called upon member countries to reduce barriers to trade and increase opportunities for businesses. 'Did anyone go to jail in Kerala?' Cong hits back at Omar amid Vande Mataram row. SRINAGAR: A day after chief minister Omar Abdullah hit out at Congress for its criticism over full rendition of Vande Mataram and wondered if the party wanted Kashmiris to be arrested, J and K Congress president Tariq Hamid Karra sharpened the attack on ally NC, describing Omar's comment as "detached from reality and highly unfortunate". Israel released 28 wild donkeys in desert; 44 years later, they created an oasis. In an effort to rejuvenate the parched landscape of Israel's Ramon Crater, wild donkeys were brought back into the ecosystem. These resilient animals played a crucial role by creating waterholes, which became essential for desert wildlife. Additionally, their droppings helped spread acacia seeds, promoting the growth of trees. Their natural movements resulted in water-retaining depressions, significantly transforming the area's ecology into a thriving environment that has caught global attention. GPS collars revealed male lions follow hyenas, not the other way around. A groundbreaking study suggests that it's the male lions that approach spotted hyenas, contrary to the belief that hyenas seek out lion remains for food. In fact, spotted hyenas are known to back away from lions, prioritizing their safety. This finding highlights the importance of spatial avoidance in hyena behavior, emphasizing their adaptive strategies to circumvent confrontations with such powerful hunters. Microsoft signs 'iron-clad' student privacy deal with teachers unions after NYC AI ban. Microsoft has signed a legally binding AI privacy agreement with the American Federation of Teachers and United Federation of Teachers, a week after Zohran Mamdani banned AI in NYC schools. The standard bars Microsoft from training AI on student data, tracking students or offering AI companion chatbots. School districts can cancel contracts over violations. Los Angeles Unified has paused student AI use, while unions want OpenAI and Anthropic to sign next.

transcript.title: Money, tax and personal finance
transcript.text: Now to your money — taxes, savings and personal finance. EPFO told to pay 6 percent interest on rupees 14 lakh PF claim after 35-day delay: What consumer commission said. The Mumbai consumer commission ruled against the EPFO, citing service deficiency linked to inadequate communication regarding a joint declaration application. Consequently, the commission mandated EPFO to pay six percent interest on the delayed EPF claim, which was filed by the complainant back in October 2016. EPFO has been instructed to fulfill this directive within a strict timeframe of forty-five days. Digital Credit and Inclusion Index: Borrowers from Tier II cities are driving India's digital credit story, finds report. Tier-2 cities in India are leading digital credit and inclusion, with an average score of 58.64, ahead of Tier-1 and Tier-3 cities, the Digital Credit and Inclusion Index (DCII) 2026 by Pahlé India Foundation and Amazon Pay found. rupees 1.17 crore interest income of minor child: Father faces rupees 12.83 lakh penalty; ITAT Delhi cancels it. Satbeer Singh Godara, judicial member and Amitabh Shukla, accountant member of ITAT Delhi, in a recent judgement ruled that a father can't be slapped with rupees 12.83 lakh penalty under Section 270A if his ITR-reported income matches the assessed income and the only point of contention is the tax benefit from the India-United Arab Emirates (UAE) DTAA treaty. He had rupees 15 lakh in savings but still lost money. Here's how a 32-year-old fixed his portfolio. A software engineer saved rupees 15 lakh but lost purchasing power due to low savings interest. Advised by a financial planner, he allocated funds effectively, setting goals for emergencies, a house, and retirement. His experience highlights how inaction can be a financial decision. rupees 2.5 crore retirement corpus: Can you get rupees 2 lakh monthly income for 25 years?. Strategic planning of retirement withdrawals from a rupees 2.5 crore fund is essential for financial security. Adopting a conservative withdrawal rate that is lower than the annual returns can help sustain the corpus. By gradually increasing withdrawals based on a fixed percentage, retirees can plan for better financial longevity. Moreover, beginning with lower withdrawals and scaling them up annually contributes positively to corpus preservation. Education loans: Parent or student , who should sign on the dotted line?. Unlike traditional consumer debt, education loans evaluate a candidate's future earning capacity rather than just existing income. EPF advance rules: You can withdraw EPF money for these 5 reasons; check limits. Members of the Employees Provident Fund Organisation can access their savings in times of need, such as emergencies and personal circumstances. Illness-related withdrawals have no limits, while education expenses allow for up to ten claims. For marriage and housing, members may withdraw funds up to five times each during their membership. Today, we calculate the minimum amount you would need to invest in your / your child's PPF per month in order to successfully become a "crorepati" over the long run. Analysts believe domestic economic conditions remain the key factor determining the direction of Indian bond yields, rather than movements in global yields alone. 8th Pay Commission news: Pensioners demand 67 percent of last pay drawn, rupees 69,000 minimum pay, 3.83 fitment factor. 8th Pay Commission latest news: Pensioners proposed a 67 percent pension of last pay drawn and a minimum pay of rupees 69,000. They also recommended one-rank-one-pension for all central government employees. The association suggested reducing the pension commutation period to eleven years. Defence pensioners' qualifying service should also be reduced on par with civil pensioners. SWP: Here's how to generate rupees 50,000 per month as steady income while keeping your corpus invested. Today, we explain how much you would have to invest in a systematic withdrawal plan (SWP) in order to receive rupees 50,000 per month as steady income after retirement, while keeping your corpus invested. Bank holidays for 4 days from September 12, 2026: Check states where banks will remain closed. Bank holidays ahead: Banking operations across several Indian states will be disrupted this week due to a series of holidays.Bank customers who have important work at their branch should plan it in advance to avoid inconvenience. rupees 20,000 extra every month: Why paying off your personal loan first may win over an SIP. With a rupees 20,000 monthly raise, borrowers must choose between repaying a personal loan or investing in mutual funds. Clearing a high-interest loan first can save more in interest and result in a larger investment corpus compared to investing the entire amount monthly. Selling insurance but not handling customer grievances: IRDAI fines IndusInd Bank rupees 1 crore; here's what policyholders should know. IndusInd Bank faces a rupees 1 crore penalty from IRDAI for failing to provide an adequate, insurance-specific grievance redressal mechanism for policyholders. Despite claims of an overall system, the regulator found a lack of dedicated channels and inadequate information, highlighting a crucial distinction between banking and insurance customer service. rupees 1 crore fine penalty: Why did IRDAI penalise Canara HSBC for mis-selling insurance to an 88-year old? What went wrong. The regulator flagged several shortcomings in the sale, including failures related to product suitability, solicitation, disclosures and the insurer's internal controls. Court orders EPFO to pay 6 percent interest for 35-day delay in settling claim , Here's how to check status, file grievances. A consumer court ordered the EPFO to pay 6 percent interest for a 35-day delay in settling a PF claim over rupees 14 lakh. The EPFO was found guilty of service deficiency, failing to meet the 20-day processing deadline as required by the EPF Scheme, 1952. Here are 7 key checks homebuyers should make, including the Commencement Certificate, sanctioned plans, RERA records, payment trail and written promises. rupees 1 crore penalty on Canara HSBC Life Insurance Company over mis-selling of a deferred annuity policy to an 88-year-old senior citizen. An 88-year-old was sold a deferred annuity policy despite age restrictions, leading to a rupees 1 crore penalty for Canara HSBC Life. IRDAI found multiple lapses in sales, underwriting, and disclosure. The regulator's order highlights crucial lessons for senior citizens buying long-term insurance products, especially via bank branches. 8th Pay Commission: How much salary hike will a 1.83 or 2.0 fitment factor give you?.
